entries.1a5a06e8ba635148: A business that covers everything from optimizing advertising strategy to planning, production and operation, in order to achieve the customer acquisition and sales targets set by clients. In addition to various media such as newspaper insert flyers, mass media advertising, events and promotional materials, the company also conducts regional revitalization business targeting government offices and local authorities, tourism consulting, digital marketing and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,340 million.

entries.3e312061404e55b0: An item covering government agency business centered on regional revitalization, and furusato nozei business.

entries.ac494dac07f62007: An item covering the planning and production of newspaper insert advertising, the production of insert flyers, and the arrangement of newspaper inserts.
entries.b668970f52743a29: This business acquires investment receivables (aggregates of individual receivables) that are traded in the secondary market among non-performing receivables that have become de facto bankrupt or bankrupt-borrower receivables, and earns investment income through the collection of those receivables. Collection management of the receivables is outsourced to a servicer. Consolidated subsidiary Invest Co., Ltd. is registered as a moneylender under the Money Lending Business Act and also provides loans to corporations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥60 million.
